summary: Stage 2C Admin Portal frontend E2E testing complete. All 15 test buckets from the review request passed. Admin login lands on /admin with HttpOnly cookie (no JWT in localStorage/sessionStorage). Dashboard renders admin-dashboard + Admin Console header + Welcome, Admin + 6 metric cards (Customers 452, Drivers 329, Total Jobs 349, Active Jobs 305, Revenue GBP 0.00, Paid Bookings 0). SideRail shows all 10 items. All 6 dashboard action rows navigate to correct routes. Search modal opens and calls /api/search on typing 2+ chars. Analytics renders all 6 sections (Marketplace/Revenue/Categories/Drivers/Customers/Operational) with zero JS errors. Users list renders 452 rows; search+clear work; suspend cancel does not fire API. Drivers list renders with all 5 filter chips (pending/changes_requested/active/suspended/all); search + review navigation OK. Driver Detail (testdriver@example.com id=3506677b-2008-4708-8e3f-a1cee03a6926, status=pending) renders admin-driver-detail, admin-approve-driver, admin-request-changes, admin-suspend-driver; admin-doc-missing warning card renders for 7 missing document types; admin-reason-modal-changes and admin-reason-modal-suspend both open. Jobs list renders 349 rows; search present. Bookings list renders 202 rows; search present. Catalog: created capability e2e_test_cap_stage2c via POST /api/admin/catalog/capabilities and deleted successfully (row disappeared). DepositBands: preview call fires on band-preview-price change; created E2E Test Band Stage 2C (id=238c9154-...) via POST /api/admin/deposit-bands and deleted successfully. Queues renders contact + newsletter tabs with 20 rows each. Profile header renders. Logout POSTs /api/auth/logout, redirects to /auth/login; revisiting /admin bounces to /auth/login (cookie cleared). Session restoration on reload works. RBAC: unauthenticated /admin/*/, /admin/users, /admin/driver/xxx, /admin/analytics all redirect to /auth/login. Customer visiting /admin is redirected to /customer. Driver visiting /admin is redirected to /driver. Zero requests to maps.googleapis.com. No AIzaSy key in DOM. Stage 2A+2B regression: customer and driver login and their portals render normally.
